row: On this channel you will find animal rescue stories based on real events. Each video is a creative reconstruction, produced from scratch using 3D animation, live-action footage and advanced digital technologies. Our mission is to remind the world that every animal deserves care and a happy life, and to inspire people everywhere to treat them with kindness and respect.
